product_metadata.title: Glicks, Aluminum Disposable Candle Holders, 40 Count
features: Easy to use, just place in candle holder and dispose when your done.
Mess free, candle holders will protect your candle sticks from melted wax
Fits well in most candle sticks including most Shabbat Candles
Made from great material, durable and can be used more than once
Great for taper candles and shabbat candles dinner candles household candles
description: Glicks aluminum and disposable candle holders are the perfect choice for keeping your candle sticks clean. They are durable and can be used again. Glicks candle holders fit most candle sticks including most shabbat candles. Glick's holders are flexible to fit larger size candles. There are 50 to a box. Try them and you will be glad you did!
